tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// gu ru drag po'i las byang me rlung 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

he ru ka khros pa'i rgyal po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo: drag sgrub thams cad kyi yang snying thugs kyi ti ka gsang ba'i yang zhun: 'di nyams su blang ba'i rim pa las byang gzhung bsrang cho ga'i rim pa bstan pa la gsum ste: sngon 'gro dang: dngos gzhi: rjes dang gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro rdzas bsham ni: gnas khang gtsang mar dkyil 'khor mda' gang 'dom gang la sogs gnas dang bstun te: rab sgrub pa'i stegs bu: 'bring dbus su chos 'byung thod phreng gis bskor ba: de'i phyi rim rtsibs bzhi: de'i phyi rim rtsibs brgyad: de'i phyi rim rtsibs bcu: sgo rdzogs grub na legs: tha ma lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu la brten no: sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gi mchod tshogs skabs dang mthun pa rgyas par bsham: rnal 'byor pa lha yi bskyed rim dang ldan pas: bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: gu ru drag po thod phreng rtsal: bdag nyid byang chub ma thob bar: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis: rdo rje drag rtsal bsgrubs nas ni: dregs pa ma lus tshar bcad nas: gzhan don skyong bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum sngon du 'gro bas 'byung gtor gtang ba ni: rang nyid skad cig gis khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ gtor ma a mṛta sa bsang*/ swa bhā ba sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las yid dang mthun pa'i snod rnams su khaṃ las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa so so'i spyod yul bzhin du 'char bar gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ sarba bigh+nān ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa dgug / sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis bsngos la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro rgyal 'jigs pa'i sku:

nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' las ni: 'byung po gang zhig 'da' byed pa: drag po chen po drag shul can: dmar nag me phreng khros nas ni: khro bo'i tshogs kyis nam mkha' gang: khro mo'i tshogs kyis sa gzhi gang: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: ming yang grags par mi 'gyur na: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐: gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐: gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho: bha ga bān: bid+yā rā dza kro dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bka' bsgo nas 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: bdag ni 'bar ba dbang gi bdag nyid de: khros pa'i ngang las khro tshogs mtshon cha'i char: rdo rje 'khor lo ral gri 'bar ba dang: rgya gram me dpung khro tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs: steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab par bsrung: bdud sde dpung bcas ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs: srung ba'i mtshams 'dir 'dug pa'i gnas med kyi: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di las 'da' ma byed: oṃ badz+ra tsakra tig+na karma kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ badz+ra bi shwa kro dha dz+wa la ma dha la hūm̐ phaṭa: dam bca' bzung ba ni/ hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro ma lus pa: thams cad chos dbyings ye shes rig pa'i klong: ma bcos lhun grub rang la rdzogs par gsal: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig bzung bar bya'o: tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ sa ma ya ti dza: byin chen dbab pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: skal ldan bdag cag sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la: sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dbab tu gsol: ye shes lnga yi dbang mchog bskur du gsol: thugs rje'i mnga' dbang dus 'dir bstsal du gsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ ā be sha ya a ā:

mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su oṃ las phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad so so'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha' rab 'byams gang ba rnams su gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da sarba pañca pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod cing rol mo bya'o// sman phud ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor gzhong bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod sdong 'dab ma stong ldan gyi snying por gtor rdzas oṃ las 'dod yon gyi phung po zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod kyi gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya hrīḥshwa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: lan gsum/ rak+ta bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i nang du raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du ra yig zhu ba las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa la khams gsum gyi rak+ta thams cad bsdus shing thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: lan gsum/ snang srid snod bcud thams cad rnam dag ye shes kyi 'khor lo thabs shes sbyor sgrol gyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dam tshig chen po'i rol mo bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes phyi nang gsang gsum byin gyis brlab bo: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/

hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog pad+ma dbang gi lha: thog med dus nas rang sems chos sku yang: rang ngo ma shes mtha' med 'khor bar 'khyams: ma rig 'khrul pa'i las dbang ci bgyis pa: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: thams dang: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum las dang po de bzhin nyid ni: hūm̐: chos rnams chos nyid spros dang bral: smra bsam brjod 'das de bzhin nyid: ma bcos rang byung chos kyi sku: 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid du brdal: oṃ ma hā shu dz+nyā tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ: hūm̐: chos rnams ye shes snying po can: ye nas sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid: de don rang gis ma shes pa: 'khrul pa'i sems can snying re rje: dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ: hūm̐: thams cad rten 'brel rgyu yi ngang: rgyu las ma byung gang yang med: hūm̐ ni rgyu yi sa bon nyid: rang byung ye shes snying por bsgom: tsit+ta badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: hūm̐: dag byed yi ge 'bru gsum gyis: snod bcud dug gsum rnam par dag: mkha' klong rnam par dag pa'i dbyings: rang byung ye shes lnga yi dngos: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: rang byung 'byung ba chen po lnga: mkha' la rlung brten gser gyi gzhi: ri rab bskal pa'i me 'bar dbus: bh+rūm̐ las ye shes gzhal yas khang: pho brang phyi nang yongs su rdzogs: chos 'byung 'bar ba e yi dbus: sgo gru rta bab chos 'khor dang: rin chen sna lnga'i rtsig pa las: steng na thod pa skam rlon brtsegs: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i gzer gyis bsdams: lha brgyad ka ba nyi zla'i gdung: gza' skar gral phyam zhing gi thogs: sbrul nag skyes bu za ra tshag: gdugs tog chos 'khor nyi zlas spras: dur khrod brgyad ldan khor yug bcas: pad rdor me ri brag chen bskor: phyi gsal nang gsal zang thal klong: dri med ye shes rgyal ba'i gnas:

zhi khro 'bar ba'i pho brang gsal: 1$0000270bh+rūm̐ 1$0000300bi shwa bi shud+dhe: e dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: baṃ ru dra ti ra baṃ: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: bh+rūm̐ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: de nas dal rtsa ba'i lha bskyed par bstan te: hūm̐: chos dbyings dag pa'i mkha' klong nas: pho brang e yi dkyil 'khor du: hūm̐ dmar 'od kyi rang bzhin babs: spro bsdu'i sbyor bas khro rgyal sku: bdag nyid rig pa'i ngo bo las: 'jigs byed rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug gri: g.yon gsum bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ sdig: zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum 'dor stabs bgrad: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa gdengs: dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs par gsal: yum chen phag mo mthing nag 'khril: gri thod 'khyud stob brkyang bskum sbyor: yab yum gsang ba'i thugs ka ru: skabs 'dir spro zhing nus na go cha lha lnga'i shog dril sbyar ba yin la/ bsdu na/ gser gyi mchod rten bum pa'i dbus// nyi zla'i steng du phyag rdor mthing*// rdo rje sdigs mdzub 'dor thabs 'gying*// de yi thugs kar ye shes sems// rdo rje khrag 'thung thugs ka ru// rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte ba la// nyi zla kha sbyor dbus su hūm̐// rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsam// spyi bor pad+ma thod phreng mthing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag ḍā ru bkal// bzhengs stabs he ru ka yi chas// de steng mkha' lding ga ru ḍa// mthing nag me gshog dug sbrul gsol// de steng rigs bdag snang mtha' yas// dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin// dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// ser nag ral gri pusti 'dzin// mgrin par rta mgrin pad+ma dbang*// dmar po dbyug to sbrul zhags bsnams// lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga ni// mthing dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i mdog

/gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ rus rgyan gsol// gsang bar yak+sha me dbal mthing*// rdo rje tho ba me zhags bsnams// kun kyang khro rngam dur khrod chas// rang srog sngags las 'od 'phros pas// rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras bcas mchod// tshur 'dus lha rnams kun la thim// byin brlabs nus pa bskyed par gyur// phung khams dpa' bo dpa' mor gsal// sku la rdo rje'i go khrab gsol// drwa mig gnam lcags sdig pas gtams// phyogs bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng: shar du rdo rje drag po rtsal: dkar po rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin: lho ru rat+na drag po rtsal: ser nag rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin: nub tu pad+ma drag po rtsal: dmar nag rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin: byang du karma drag po rtsal: ljang nag rdo rje sdig pa 'dzin: kun kyang khro gtum rngam zhing 'jigs: dur khrod chas brgyad 'bar ba'i sku: de yi phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo rdo rje gri thod 'dzin: lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo rin chen gri thod 'dzin: nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo pad+ma gri thod 'dzin: byang du karma mkha' 'gro ma: ljang nag rgya gram gri thod 'dzin: kun kyang sgeg cing brkyang bskum bgrad: g.yang gzhi stag sham rgyan drug spras: shar lhor gshin rje ser nag 'bar: 'khor lo lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin: lho nub khros ma nag mo ni: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: nub byang badz+ra kī la ya: ljang nag phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs: byang shar mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: mthing nag gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: kun kyang baṃ gyi gdan la bzhugs: dur khrod chas gsol me klong bzhugs: phyi rim rang byung khro rgyal bcu: 'jigs pa'i khro rgyal 'bar ba'i sku: rang rtags phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin: kun kyang hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing bzhugs: dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi ru: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: gzhan yang lha dang rig 'dzin tshogs:

dpag med sprin tshogs lta bur gtibs: kun kyang ma 'dres 'ja' tshon ltar: yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor chen por bsgom: badz+ra gu ru kro dha sarba sa ma ya: a mi dhe wa: khrauṃ ga ru ṇa: ya mān+ta ka: ha ya grī wa: badz+ra pā ṇi: ha ri ni sa: badz+ra yak+sha ya ma rā dza badz+ra bha ra hi kī la ya siṃ ha mu kha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: de nas sha chen spos bsreg rol mos byin dbab cing spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: zangs mdog dpal ri'i gnas mchog gi: pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: khrag 'thung khro bo rol pa yi: dmar nag me yi klong dkyil nas: gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rigs kyi bdag po gshegs su gsol: ri rab 'bar ba'i rtse mo nas: khyung chen 'bar ba gshegs su gsol: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sku mchog 'jam dpal gshegs su gsol: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: pad+ma dbang chen gshegs= lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas: gsang bdag gtum po gshegs= dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: mkha' 'gro ging bcas gshegs= rab 'jigs gtum po'i dur khrod nas: tshe bdag nag po gshegs= bde chen gsang ba'i gnas mchog nas: rdo rje phag mo gshegs= me dpung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: badz+ra kī la gshegs= gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro seng gdong gshegs= rtsub 'gyur me yi 'khrugs klong nas: yak+sha me dbal gshegs= rang bzhin gzhal yas thams cad nas: rig 'dzin yi dam mkha' 'gro ging: dam can chos skyong srung mar bcas: thams cad ma lus gshegs su gsol: rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: cod pan dar dpyang pu ru ru: bskal pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: dur khrod rgyan cha spungs se spung: hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra ti ri ri: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: gu ru badz+ra kro dha dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

bzhugs gsol ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod chen po me klong 'bar ba'i dbus: dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: khro rgyal dregs 'joms drag po'i lha tshogs rnams: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: gu ru badz+ra kro dha dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: drag po thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: hūm̐ sgra sgrog cing bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad lha: 'bar ba'i khro rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar gyis phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas mchod pa rnam gsum 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: me tog dang ni bdug spos dang: mar me dri chab zhal zas dang: sil snyan yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin: kun bzang bla med mchod sprin 'di: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: nang mchod ni/ hūm̐: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: phung po lnga nyid ye shes lnga: 'dod yon glu gar mchod yid tshim: rnam dag mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā pañca pū dza ho: gsang mchod ni/

hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med: gnyis med sbyor ba'i 'phro 'du las: byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phro: thabs shes bde ba chen por bzhes: ma hā mu dra sa ma ya gu h+ya pū dza ho: sman mchod ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir: dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi che: ngo mtshar rmad byung ye shes mchog: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la: mnyam nyid chen por 'bul lags na: thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol: bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag la: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: snang ba mtha' yas spyan gzigs pad+ma 'byung*// mtsho rgyal rat+na gling pa tshe dbang grags// bka' bab nyer lnga rtsa brgyud bla ma la// rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul// dbang drag pad+ma yab yum go cha'i lha// drag rtsal mkha' 'gro 'jigs byed khro bo bcu// sgo ma bzhi sogs yi dam dkyil 'khor la// rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul// dam can sde bdun bdud mgon lcam dral dang*// spu gri mched gsum smyo kha mkha' ri sogs// chos skyong gter srung dam can rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog gi mnyes mchod 'bul// zhes lha dang srung ma thams cad la mtshan don sbyar nas 'bul lo// kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wā ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes dngos grub blang*/ hūm̐: dam rdzas gtor chen 'bar ba 'di: brjid ldan ro mchog brgya dang ldan: 'dod yon lha mo'i tshogs kyis spras: ye shes rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'dis: rtsa ba gsum gyi thugs dam bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: ma rig log rtog 'khrul pa yi: zhing bcu gdug pa'i ru dra bsgral:

lcang lor bcas pa'i bhan+dha ru: khams gsum bsgral pa'i rak+ta bskyil: khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i lha tshogs kyi: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: yang dag don rtogs shes rab kyis: gzung 'dzin gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral: rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams de la dgyes: chos dbyings rol pa'i mchod pa bzhes: ma traṃ ru dra pra bhan tsakra pra be sha ya khā hi: zhes phyi nang gsang gsum sman gtor rak+ta la sogs rim par rol mo'i tshogs kyis mchod: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ de nas bstod pa rgyas bsdus bskul dang gsum las: spro na las byang gi gtso 'khor don rtags dang mthun par bstod/ bsdu na/ hrī: dmar nag 'bar ba me yi klong dkyil nas: spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro don skur sprul pa: dregs pa 'dul mdzad drag po thod phreng rtsal: bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus: bdud dang dregs pa ru dra bsnol ba'i steng: rab tu 'jigs pa'i sku mchog khyad par can: me yi mdog can sku che yan lag rags: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs rkan sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: ag tshom me 'bar smin ma glog ltar 'khyugs: ral pa dmar ser srid gsum rtse mor 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing bgegs rnams 'joms: g.yon pas sdig pa mgo dgus snying khrag 'jib: thod phreng skam rlon sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: glang chen ko rlon zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol: dpa' bo'i sku la stag gi sham thabs gsol: rdo rje'i go khrab rgyan drug dag gis spras: dbang drag sku la go cha'i lha rnams rdzogs: dbu gtsug rigs bdag sprul pa'i bya khyung dkar: dpral bar 'jam dpal mgrin par rta mgrin dang: thugs kar gsang bdag lte bar dhā ki lnga: gsang ba'i gnas su yak+sha me dbal te: kun kyang rang rtags phyag mtshan rgyan dang ldan: khyod kyi sku la mtshon cha 'bar ba'i tshogs: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kun tu khyab: nyid kyi sprul pa yak+sha me dbal tshogs: skar ltar 'khrug cing rlung ltar 'tshubs pa la:

mtshon cha'i 'khor lo g.yas g.yon 'khor byed cing: 'khor lo'i bar na rgyal bsen sde brgyad rnams: phye mar gtub cing rdul phran bzhin du brlag: gdug pa can rnams sngangs shing brgyal bar byed: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa'i bar chad rnams: thal ba bzhin du ma lus rlag par byed: lha yi nang nas lhag pa'i mthu bo che: rgyal ba kun gyi mthu rtsal lhag pa'i lha: dngos grub glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rje can: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi bar mdzod: sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen bzlog tu gsol: byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru drag po rtsal: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: de nas thun mong du bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: drag po thod phreng rig 'dzin lha yi tshogs: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i dus bar du: rang rig dbyer med lha dang ma mjal te: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul rtog ma rig dbang gyur pas: dbyer med chos dbyings klong du bzod par gsol: oṃ gu ru satwa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya bzla'o: skabs 'dir sgrub thabs gsum gang rung ltar 'dzab zhi drag sbrel te brgya'am stong la sogs pa bya'o: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūṃ ā: zhes zhi ba'i snying po'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ces rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'o// badz+ra hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces me dbal dang sde brgyad sham bu'o// oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐ hrī: oṃ khroṃ ga ru ṇa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭṛ wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: dhā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: ya ma rā dza: badz+ra bha ra hi: badz+ra kī li kī la ya:

badz+ra siṃ ha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ces 'dzab brgya stong la sogs ci nus gtso 'khor gyi 'gros dang sbyar te bzla'o// de nas bsod nams rgya chen tshogs kyi rim pa bya ste: zhing ngam gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i steng du: tshogs kyi yo byad rgyas par bsham: bsang chu 'thor zhing: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐: sarba dra byaṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bsang ngo*// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ swā hā: hūm̐: ngang nyid rdo rje'i chos dbyings las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bru gsum gyis: dngos 'dzin mtshan ma'i bag chags sbyangs: dag par ma gyur gang yang med: dag pa'i ngang du gnas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: byin rlabs 'phro 'du'i 'od zer gyis: dpag med nam mkha'i mthar gyur pa'i: 'dod pa'i longs spyod sprin ltar gtibs: hūm̐ gis rnam rtog dbyings su bsgral: āḥyis dri med bdud rtsir bsgyur: oṃ gyis 'dod yon sprin tshogs gtibs: hrīḥyis snang srid mchod pas bkang: mchod pa'i lha mo dpag med kyis: gser dngul g.yu yi gzhong pa nas: longs spyod dpag med tshogs kyis bkang: gar dang phyag rgya bsgyur zhing mchod: a la la te mchod pa bzhes: dgyes bskangs bdag la dngos grub stsol: tshogs lha spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: rje btsun pad+ma drag po rtsal: go cha lha lnga gtso dang 'khor: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging dang bcas: sku la sgrib sems mi mnga' yang: 'gro rnams bsod nams gsag pa'i phyir: ye shes tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de nas rim pa gsum du bcad de: dang po mchod: bar pa skong bshags: tha ma bsgral bar byas te: dang po tshogs phud phul la: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa chen pos rol nas kyang: 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi:

bar pa bshags pa ni: dpang gyur skyabs mchog ma lus rnams: tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar: 'gal 'khrul nyams chag ma lus pa: tshogs kyis bskang zhing bshags par bgyi: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra khā hi shud+dhe a: tha ma liṅgar 'gugs bstim spyi ltar bya: ging pa dkar nag chas su zhugs te: hūm̐: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: rngam brjid 'bar ba'i khro tshogs bcas: rdo rje phur pa lcags kyu dang: zhags pa tho chen 'bar ba thogs: dgra bgegs gdug pa'i lnga phung 'di: lcags kyus zungs la phur pas thob: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su spor: gu ru badz+ra kro dha nṛ tri dgra bgegs shā trun mā ra ya rbad: ces bsgral nas bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro zhal phyes shig: khams gsum yongs sgrol dgra bgegs zhal du bstabs: rngams byed hom khung yangs pa'i mgul du bstim: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ngang du mchod par bzhes: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas rdo rje slob dpon sogs la rim par drang ste: kye: gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: 'di la the tshom byar mi rung: bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: lag gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgyas blangs te: ho: rin thang med la legs 'ong chos: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma kun spangs pa'i: blang dor chos kun bral ba yi: de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal: a la la ho: zhes rol lo: de nas lhag ma'i cho ga bya ste: lag pa mkha' gsang gi phyag rgyas kha phru btab ste: phud lhag bsres la: rkang gi gzar bus rak+ta gtor zhing rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la 'chams stabs dang bstun te: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ swa bhā ba sogs/ tshogs gzhong bhan+dha'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ lhag ma'i ngo bo de nyid/ 'dod yon gyi longs spyod/

sha chen gyi phung po/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho stong gsum gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ sngags 'dis lan gsum byin brlabs nas: hūm̐: chos dbyings rol pa chen po las: sprul pa'i khro rgyal chen po shar: 'khor 'das snang srid nga yi dbang: nga ni che mchog he ru ka: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: drag po'i lha tshogs phud la dgyes: bar du lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: dam can mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: rnal 'byor bdag dang g.yar dam gcig: dkyil 'khor mtha' la mi bzhag rgyu: bran g.yog pho mo'i tshul la gnas: drag po'i bka' nyan las byed tshogs: shar gyi phyogs kyi gtor len ni: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: lho yi phyogs kyi gtor len ni: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: nub kyi phyogs kyi gtor len ni: pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: byang gi phyogs kyi gtor len ni: las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ging dang laṅka dur khrod bdag: ke seng dbang phyug nyer brgyad sogs: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud rnams: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rgyan cha mang po khro lo lo: dpa' bo'i bro brdung khrabs se khrab: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: gnas bzang dur khrod nyams re dga': gos bzang zhing lpags brjid re che: skyogs bzang bhan+dha mtshan re bzang: skyems bzang rak+ta bcud re che: zas bzang māṃ sa ro re zhim: rtag tu dur khrod gnas rnams nyul: dam tshig bsrung zhing mkha' la 'gro: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: yang dag don la sangs rgyas kyang: thabs kyis drag po'i phrin las mdzad: rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod las: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ badz+ra bhā ra yo gi nī dhā ka dhā ki nī ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lhag ma'i gtor ma btang ngo : de nas chad mdo ni:

gtor ma rnams dkyil 'khor nas gom pa bdun bcu'i sar dpags la: phud dang rak+ta phyogs bcur gtor: rol mo bsgrags la 'di skad do: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: slob dpon pad+ma spyan drangs tshe: yang le shod nas bod yul byon: mang yul la nas mar byon tshe: lha srin dam la 'dogs shing byon: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung: sde brgyad dbang du mi btang 'tshal: gdug pa'i sde brgyad thul bar mdzod: khyed rnams lha 'dre de yi rigs: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' ma bcag: rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' zhig: gtsang gi chu mig gnas pa der: dge bsnyen thams cad dam la btags: rgyas par na/ 1$0000250bdag ni rig 'dzin 1$0000300 sogs re re bzhin sbyar/ bsdu na gsham du tshar gcig sbyar bas 'thus so// gnubs kyi ru thog brag dmar der: dri za pho mo dam la btags: g.yu mtsho phyug mo'i nang shed nas: pho rgyud mo rgyud dam la btags: 'brog gi na dmar rgod gang der: lha btsan thams cad dam la btags: ma dros kun gyi rgya mtsho der: klu rigs thams cad dam la btags: ru dam lung pa nag po der: ma yams thams cad dam= sil ma gtsang gi gangs dkar der: sman dang lha sman dam= kha rag gangs kyi lho phyogs der: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam= gtsang gi kha rag yul gong der: 'brog gnas thams cad dam= bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum der: rgyal po thams cad dam la btags: 'gos kyi gla ba rkang gcig der: the'u rang thams cad dam la btags: bdag ni rig 'dzin de yi gdung: sde brgyad dbang du mi btang 'tshal: gdug pa'i sde brgyad thul bar mdzod: khyed rnams lha 'dre de yi rigs: sngon tshe slob dpon bka' ma bcag: da lta sngags 'chang dam ma bkral: rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces tha tshig gis gnad nas bskul zhing chad mdo bya'o: de nas brtan ma skyong ste:

bh+yo: 'jig rten bod khams skyong mdzad pa'i: brtan ma bcu gnyis dpon dang g.yog: dpal gnas ma dang yang dag shes: kong lha g.yu bun khyung btsun ma: me tog zla 'od byang rgyal ma: gser thang kun bzang shān+tiṃ dpal: klu mo gzi 'bar la sogs pa'i: brtan ma skyong mdzad 'khor dang bcas: khyed rnams sngon gyi g.yar dam can: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang: slob ma rlangs chen dpal seng gis: zhing chen bkram pa'i gdan steng du: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi gral du bzhag: ma 'ongs sangs rgyas lung yang bstan: dbang bskur cod pan spyi bor bzhag: dbang rtags rdo rje phur pa gtad: lce la dam tshig bdud rtsi bzhag: dam tshig gnyan gyi gral du bcug: da rung khyed rnams 'jig rten ma 'das pas: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam mnos bzhin: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ lo ka lo ki nī ma ma hrīng hrīng: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ces brjod la gtor gzhong bdud rtsis bshal te mchod do: de nas rta bro ni las byang gang yang rung ba ltar bya bar gsungs pas/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsams la/ rdo rje'i rgyas gdab dang bcas pas/

hūm̐: nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste: khams gsum thams cad spyi nas gnon: dgra bgegs sdig chen 'byung po rnams: dug gsum las kyi brub khung mnan: mnan no bcings so s+t+wam+bha ya: rdo rje'i bro yi rgyas btab pas: sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: s+t+wam+bha ya nan: zhes khro bo'i stangs stabs kyis bro bya'o: nang du log nas tshe 'gugs bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya bar gsungs pas/ dang po tshe 'gugs pa ni/ bdag nyid tshe dpag med pa ji lta ba bzhin bskyed: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshe bcud bsdus par bsam: oṃ badz+ra ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ hrī: ci 'grub bzla/ de nas tshe yi mda' dar dmar po g.yab cing 'di skad do/ hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: gsang ba thugs kyi bum pa nas: snying po thugs kyi ā yu stsol: bdag cag rdo rje'i tshe thob shog: ces bskul/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid: phrin las 'dus pa'i drag po thod phreng rtsal: rnam dag sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub bstsal du gsol: spros med mkha' ltar dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba: dngos grub stsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang: las dang thugs rje mthun pa'i rten 'brel gyis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol: rgyal ba rnams kyis thugs rje'i rang bzhin gyis: sgrub po bdag ni skal ldan dam tshig can: dbang chen drag po'i dngos grub mchog chen po: dus 'dir bdag la yongs rdzogs bstsal du gsol: ces pa'i mthar rtsa sngags sham bcas brjod/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod spro na skabs 'dir bya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya dang*/ ma rnyed yongs su sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ dbang don dkyil 'khor sogs dang 'brel na ye shes pa gshegs pa'am brtan bzhugs spyi mthun bya/

dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu zhing*/ bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐: chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor ma 'dres yongs rdzogs shar: gang 'dul 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal kun bsal nas: slar yang skye med chos dbyings ngang du mu: lhar ldang ba ni/ hūm̐: rang lus 'byung ba lnga dang skye mched tshogs: ye nas rang byung rang gsal yi dam lha: thabs shes dbyer med lta spyod zung 'brel nas: rgyun du 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: lus lha'i dkyil 'khor ye shes sems dpar gsal gdab: rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lubs su gon par bsams te rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o: smon lam ni: na mo: bdag gis bla ma bsgrubs la sogs: dus gsum tshogs gnyis ci bsags pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur cig: yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs nas: phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing: bdag gzhan gnyis med sangs rgyas shog: shis brjod ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum bla ma sku gsum bdag nyid can: dbyer med rang la rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: thabs shes zung 'jug snang stong yi dam lha: don dam 'du 'bral med pa'i bkra shis shog: 'khor 'das chos la dbang bsgyur mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: phyi nang bar chad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: mthu stobs bdud 'dul bka' srung gter bdag tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i bkra shis shog: ces sogs rgyas par brjod do/ kye ma: dus kyi snyigs ma lnga bcu kha ral dus: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar la ma smin pas: gsang sngags zer zhing bcos ma'i chos kyis gang: ltar snang legs kyang grub rtags thon mi med: de lta'i dus na rgya 'gyur ma 'phyugs pa: pad+ma'i thugs gter yin gyis nyams su longs: skal ldan las can gcig dang 'phrad nas kyang: gsang sngags mi nub bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog: mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring a tham rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pas byi ba'i lo la lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas gdan drangs te/

lo bcu la bka' rgya bsdams nas/ bya yi lo la sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang sne gdong du/ shog ser zheng mkhyud gang*/ dkyus mtho gang ba gcig las zhal bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni rje nyid kyi sras dbang chen bzang pos bgyis pa'o// zhes gter gzhung rtsa ba bcos bslad med pa la zur 'debs dgos rigs rnams dbang sgrub sogs kyi skabs su khyer bde bar nag 'gros su bgyis pa la 'gal ba gang mchis bshags shing*/ dge bas pad+ma drag po myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge legs 'phel// //
